structured_output.hypothesis: If bats occur on almost every oceanic island and remote ones often have endemic species, then most oceanic islands or island groups will have at least one georeferenced native bat (Chiroptera) record, and a substantial fraction of them will have bat species found nowhere else.
structured_output.pass_criterion: Use a pre-listed set of at least 40 oceanic (never continent-connected, volcanic or coral) islands or archipelagos, each at least 100 km2 and at least 300 km from the nearest continent. At least 80% of them have at least one GBIF Chiroptera occurrence with a preserved-specimen or human-observation basisOfRecord. That record must be in the island's coordinates or island/countryCode field and must not be flagged introduced. In addition, at least 25% of the islands or groups that have bats host at least one bat species whose entire GBIF-recorded range lies within that island group.
structured_output.fail_criterion: Fewer than 60% of the listed oceanic islands or archipelagos have any native bat occurrence record. Alternatively, fewer than 10% of the bat-bearing ones have an endemic bat species. Results between these thresholds count as inconclusive and do not confirm the claim.
structured_output.interpretation: Darwin's 'ærial mammals' means bats (Chiroptera). 'Almost every island' is read as at least 80% of a pre-specified list of oceanic islands. 'Oceanic' is the modern sense of never joined to a continent and remote from one. 'Endemic' means a species whose GBIF records fall only within one island or archipelago, checked against the GBIF taxonomic backbone. Modern reinterpretation: sampling effort is uneven, so absence of a record is treated as absence only for islands with at least 100 total GBIF mammal or vertebrate records. Islands below that count are excluded, not scored as failures. Introduced bats are excluded using establishmentMeans.

dataset.name: GBIF Occurrence Data: Chiroptera (taxonKey 734)
dataset.why_it_fits: GBIF serves global bat occurrence records through a free API at https://api.gbif.org/v1/occurrence/search. The fields used would be taxonKey=734, scientificName, speciesKey, decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, countryCode, island, islandGroup, establishmentMeans and basisOfRecord. These allow counting bat species per island and identifying single-island-group endemics. A download made at test time receives its own citable DOI.
